# Zanzibaba Studios — Zanzibar's Visual Media Platform

## About
Zanzibaba Studios is Zanzibar's visual media platform. We produce, broadcast and license premium photography, video and drone content documenting tourism, construction, real estate, culture, marine, business and events across Zanzibar.

## Services
- Video Production
- Photography
- Drone Services
- Hotel Photography
- Content Creation
- Live Streaming
- Event Coverage

## Locations
- Headquarters: Stone Town & Paje, Zanzibar, Tanzania
- Service coverage: Zanzibar, Paje, Nungwi, Kendwa, Kiwengwa, Jambiani, Matemwe, Stone Town, Bwejuu, Michamvi

## Industries Served
- Hotels & Resorts
- Villas
- Tours
- Investors
- Restaurants
- NGOs
- Government
